title: Plugin result envelopes were read outside the protected boundary, so a throwing getter could put its message into a 500 answer
resolution: The service reads each provider factory and resolver envelope once inside the try into a plain snapshot; a throwing getter or a malformed envelope is the sanitized plugin defect, with service and HTTP tests on the answer and the logs.

title: The in-memory binding store checked a captured integration revision after an await, so an integration update could slip in before the write
resolution: The in-memory integrations store serializes its writes with the binding put through one shared exclusive section, as the PostgreSQL row lock does; a deterministic test pauses after the integration snapshot.

title: The stored and the resolved origin went through different normalizations, and an unparsable resolved URL could throw
resolution: Both origins use normalizeOrigin on the authority as written, without WHATWG URL canonicalization; a resolved URL whose origin does not normalize is the sanitized plugin defect, tested with a numeric host.

title: The verification record claimed HTTP tests for every resolver case and every 422 body that the route suite lacked
resolution: The route suite adds a throwing plugin, a value naming another repository, and a BindingRefusal check of every 422; the record states the evidence per suite.

title: The conformance case on an update during a held put observed the wait with a fixed 50 ms sleep
resolution: The target's untilUpdateWaits observes the wait: in memory an exclusive call queued behind running work, in PostgreSQL the update's backend in a Lock wait, polled to a 30 s deadline.

title: The binding 409 description omitted a revision named while the project is unbound
resolution: The OpenAPI 409 description and wire section 4 name a revision sent for an unbound project; the generated web client is unchanged.

title: The one-plugin lookup was duplicated in the binding and the integration compositions
resolution: singlePlugin builds the lookup once in startScmIntegrationServices, which passes it to both services; RepositoryBindingPorts takes plugins.

title: A plugin defect became a bare 500 with no record of the failing plugin call
resolution: Each defect is reported once through ScmPluginDefects and logged as scm.plugin.defect with integration, plugin, operation, and kind only; service and HTTP tests check that no secret reaches it.
